name: binance
description: Binance spot market data — candles, price, order book, trades, and a 24h turnover screen. Read-only: it holds no API key and declares no account or order action. Covers thousands of pairs, so it is the venue to use for a coin Upbit does not list. Prices are quoted in USDT (or another quote asset), never in KRW; converting to KRW needs a separate exchange-rate lookup. For a coin that trades on Upbit, prefer Upbit — that is where the orders actually execute.

actions.name: Candles (OHLCV)
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 캔들 OHLCV 봉 차트 데이터 — 일봉·시간봉·분봉·월봉. Broker-neutral candles: date, open, high, low, close, volume, quote volume, trade count. 1000봉 상한을 넘어 최대 20,000봉까지 자동 페이징하므로 다년치 분석이 한 번에 끝납니다. technical-analysis 에 캐시키로 넘기십시오.

params.symbol: Pair or base asset — BTCUSDT, BTC, BTC/USDT all resolve
params.interval: 1s 1m 3m 5m 15m 30m 1h 2h 4h 6h 8h 12h 1d 3d 1w 1M — CASE SENSITIVE, 1m is a minute and 1M is a month
params.limit: How many bars (default 500, up to 20000 via paging)
params.start: Oldest bar, YYYY-MM-DD or epoch ms (optional)
params.end: Newest bar, YYYY-MM-DD or epoch ms (optional)

actions.name: Last price
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 현재가 가격 시세 조회 — 마지막 체결가 한 줄. Latest traded price for one pair, the cheapest way to answer what a coin is worth right now.

actions.name: 24h statistics
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 24시간 통계 등락률 고가 저가 거래량 거래대금. Rolling 24-hour open, high, low, last, percent change and volume for one pair, or every pair when the symbol is omitted.

params.symbol: Pair or base asset; omit for all pairs (heavy)

actions.name: Best bid and ask
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 최우선 호가 매수호가 매도호가 스프레드. Top of the order book with the resting quantities and the spread as a percentage — whether a quoted price is actually tradable.

actions.name: Recent average price
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 평균가 5분 평균 가격. The venue's own 5-minute average price, steadier than the last trade when the book is thin.

actions.name: Order book depth
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 호가창 심도 매수잔량 매도잔량 오더북. Bid and ask levels with quantities; deeper requests cost more of the rate allowance.

actions.name: Recent trades
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 체결 내역 최근 거래 체결가 체결량 매수매도. Recent individual trades with price, quantity, time, and which side was the taker — the side that moved the price.

actions.name: Aggregated trades
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 집계 체결 내역 기간 지정. Trades filled by one taker order at one price merged into a single row — cheaper and less noisy than raw trades, and it accepts a time range.

actions.name: Turnover ranking
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 거래대금 순위 급등 코인 종목 화면 스크리닝 랭킹. Every pair of one quote asset ranked by 24-hour turnover — the screen for what is moving right now.

params.quote: Quote asset to rank within (default USDT)
params.minTurnover: Drop pairs under this 24h quote volume

actions.name: Tradable pairs
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 상장 종목 목록 페어 마켓 조회. Every spot pair currently trading with its base and quote asset — confirm a coin is listed before quoting it.

params.quote: Only pairs with this quote asset (optional)

actions.name: Exchange clock
actions.description: 바이낸스 binance 거래소 서버 시각. The venue's current time, for when a timestamp disagreement is suspected.

action.description: Binance public market-data action. get_candles is the broker-neutral candle contract. screen ranks a quote asset's pairs by 24h turnover. No account or order action exists here. klines is accepted as an alias of get_candles — it is the venue's own word.

symbol.description: Pair or base asset. BTCUSDT, BTC, btc/usdt and BTC-USDT all resolve to BTCUSDT; a bare base asset takes the quote parameter (USDT by default).

quote.description: Quote asset — completes a bare base asset, and selects which pairs screen and symbols return. Default USDT. Binance has no KRW pairs.

interval.description: Candle interval, CASE SENSITIVE: 1s 1m 3m 5m 15m 30m 1h 2h 4h 6h 8h 12h 1d 3d 1w 1M. '1m' is one minute and '1M' is one month. Default 1d.

limit.description: How many rows. Candles page past the venue's 1000 cap up to 20000; order book allows 5000; trades allow 1000.

start.description: Range start — YYYY-MM-DD or epoch milliseconds. Interpreted as UTC.

end.description: Range end — YYYY-MM-DD or epoch milliseconds. Interpreted as UTC.

top.description: screen: how many ranked rows to return (1-200, default 30).

minTurnover.description: screen: drop pairs whose 24h turnover in the quote asset is below this.

includeStable.description: screen: keep stablecoin-against-stablecoin pairs (USDC/USDT and the like). They top every turnover ranking without moving, so they are excluded by default.

data.description: Response payload; shape depends on the action

trade.description: 바이낸스 binance 실시간 체결 스트림 — 틱 단위 체결가·체결량이 밀려옵니다. Live trade ticks. The stream name must be LOWERCASE (btcusdt@trade); pass `code` in lowercase.
